ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_inverse_advantage_reweight_loss
ir.intuition: This loss flips the standard advantage weighting by inversely weighting pairs with larger advantage gaps, encouraging learning from harder, less certain comparisons by downweighting very easy pairs. Instead of a margin-based or sigmoid-logsigmoid link, it uses a tanh link on the difference of log probabilities, modulated by an inverse advantage-based weight. Aggregation is a clipped mean to reduce outlier influence, forming a distinct paradigm shift emphasizing hard pairs with smooth gradients.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
inv_adv_weight = 1 / (abs(advantage_gap) + epsilon)
scaled_diff = alpha * diff
tanh_loss = 0.5 * (1 - tanh(scaled_diff))
weighted_loss = inv_adv_weight * tanh_loss
clipped_weighted_loss = clamp(weighted_loss, 0, clip_val)
if weight:
  clipped_weighted_loss *= weight
loss = mean(clipped_weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('clip_val', 5.0)))
    eps = 1e-6
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    abs_adv = ops.abs(adv)
    inv_adv_weight = ops.div(ops.ones_like(abs_adv), ops.add(abs_adv, eps))
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, diff)
    tanh_vals = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)
    tanh_loss = ops.mul(0.5, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(tanh_vals), tanh_vals))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(inv_adv_weight, tanh_loss)
    clipped_loss = ops.clamp(weighted_loss, 0.0, clip_val)
    if weight is not None:
        clipped_loss = ops.mul(clipped_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(clipped_loss)
